map.输入层厚、填充率、模型体积与打印速度，估算 FDM 打印总时长、耗材质量与长度。: Enter layer height, infill ratio, model volume and print speed to estimate total FDM print time, filament mass and length.
map.有效体积 = 模型体积 × (0.25+0.75×填充率)；打印时间 = 有效体: Effective volume = model volume times (0.25+0.75 times infill); print time = effective volume / flow.
map.基于 FDM 3D 打印时间模型：有效体积按填充率线性折算（最低 25%）；体积: Based on the FDM 3D-print time model: effective volume scales linearly with infill (min 25%); volumetric flow = speed times layer height times nozzle diameter; print time = effective volume / flow, for print scheduling and filament estimation.
map.💡 公式：有效体积 = 模型体积×(0.25+0.75×填充率)；体积流量 =: Formula: effective volume = model volume times (0.25+0.75 times infill); volumetric flow = speed times layer height times nozzle diameter; print time = effective volume / flow; filament mass = effective volume times density.
map.模型体积可由切片软件读取，或按长×宽×高估算: Model volume can be read from slicer software or estimated as length times width times height.
map.实际时间受加速度、回抽、空走、底层影响，建议上浮 10%～20%: Actual time is affected by acceleration, retraction, travel and the first layer; add 10% to 20%.
map.密度：PLA≈1.24，ABS≈1.04，PETG≈1.27 g/cm³: Density: PLA approx 1.24, ABS approx 1.04, PETG approx 1.27 g/cm3.
map.📚 深度解析：3D 打印时间估算（FDM 时长、耗材质量与长度）: In-depth: 3D printing time estimation (FDM duration, filament mass and length)
map.打印排期：按层厚、填充率与体积估算完成时间: Print scheduling: estimate completion time by layer height, infill and volume.
map.耗材核算：估算所需耗材质量与丝长，判断是否够料: Filament accounting: estimate required filament mass and length to judge sufficiency.
map.参数优化：比较不同层厚/填充率对时长与耗材的影响: Parameter optimization: compare the effect of different layer heights/infill on time and filament.
map.算法：有效体积 Veff = V×(0.25 + 0.75×填充率/100)（c: Algorithm: effective volume Veff = V times (0.25 + 0.75 times infill/100) (cm3, 0.25 is the fixed share of walls/top-bottom shells);
map.= 打印速度×层厚×喷嘴直径（mm³/s）；打印时间 = Veff×1000/流: = print speed times layer height times nozzle diameter (mm3/s); print time = Veff times 1000 / flow (s), shown as Xh Ym Zs; filament mass = Veff times density (g, PLA 1.24, ABS 1.04 g/cm3); filament cross-section = pi times (diameter/2)^2; filament length = Veff times 1000 / cross-section / 10 (cm); estimated time with 15% margin given separately.
map.例：层厚 0.2mm、填充 20%、体积 30cm³、速度 60mm/s、喷嘴: Example: layer height 0.2 mm, infill 20%, volume 30 cm3, speed 60 mm/s, nozzle 0.4 mm, density 1.24 g/cm3, filament 1.75 mm -> Veff 12.00 cm3, flow 4.80 mm3/s, time 2500 s (0h 41m 39s), filament 14.9 g, length 498.9 cm (~5.0 m), with margin 0h 47m 54s. If infill raised to 100% -> Veff 30.00 cm3, time 6250 s (1h 44m 9s), filament 37.2 g, length 1247.3 cm (~12.5 m), both 2.5 times. If layer height dropped to 0.1 mm and infill 100% -> flow 2.40 mm3/s, time 12500 s (3h 28m 19s).
map.估算值为什么总比切片软件短？: Why is the estimate always shorter than the slicer?
map.本工具只按体积流量算纯挤出时间，未计入空驶行程（G0 移动）、每层回抽、Z 轴抬: This tool only computes pure extrusion time by volumetric flow, not travel moves (G0), per-layer retraction, Z lift, acceleration/deceleration and slow first layer. Actual total time is usually 20% to 50% longer, so the tool gives a 15%-margin reference, but the slicer result still prevails.
map.0.25 的固定壳体占比合理吗？: Is the fixed 0.25 shell share reasonable?
map.这是一个把外壁与顶底层折算进有效体积的经验系数，对中等尺寸、周长 2~3 圈的常: This is an empirical coefficient folding walls and top/bottom layers into effective volume, fitting mid-size models with 2 to 3 perimeter loops. Very small parts (high shell share) are underestimated, very large solid parts (low shell share) overestimated; use the slicer actual extrusion for precision.
map.FDM 3D 打印时间估算器，基于层厚、填充率、模型体积与打印速度，结合体积流量: The FDM 3D-print time estimator, based on layer height, infill, model volume and print speed, with the volumetric-flow model estimates total print time, filament mass and length.
